title: Embedding
description: A fingerprint (meaning vector) of an image piece or a text prompt. Veil contract v1.0. Units: positions and sizes are integer screen pixels with the origin at the top-left of the display in its current orientation (x grows right, y grows down); times are integer milliseconds on one monotonic clock (Android SystemClock.uptimeMillis; replays use a virtual clock in the same unit); fingerprints are L2-normalised vectors stored as float16. A fingerprint may only be compared with a concept from the same model family: both must carry the same spaceId.

spaceId.description: Model family the fingerprint belongs to.

modelId.description: The model that produced it; matches ModelManifest.modelId.

vectorF16.description: Standard base64 with padding of dim little-endian IEEE-754 binary16 values, L2-normalised. The byte length 2 x dim is checked by rules.py.

regionId.description: Region the fingerprint was computed from.
